D: A city teenager moves to a small town where dancing is banned, and decides to change that.
P: Serve the snacks when Ren starts teaching Willard to dance.
S: the burger joint where the town's teenagers hang out

Little chuck patties smashed thin with melted cheddar, pickles, mustard and grilled onion on soft slider buns, with a tray of crinkle-cut fries. Cook 500g frozen crinkle-cut fries at 220C for 20 minutes. Roll 500g chuck mince into 12 balls. Cook a thinly sliced onion on a hot flat plate until soft and brown. Smash the balls flat on the plate, season and cook 2 minutes, flip and add half a slice of cheddar. Toast 12 slider buns, add mustard and pickles, and stack in the patties and onions.
Buttermilk-marinated chicken pieces fried crisp, honey for dipping
Chicken thigh pieces marinated in buttermilk overnight, dredged in flour and paprika, fried at 180C until crisp, with honey to dip.
Golden corn fritters with a chive sour cream dip
Corn kernels mixed with flour, egg, spring onion and paprika, fried in spoonfuls until golden, with a sour cream and chive dip.
M: Garlic thyme beef blade roasted tender with potatoes, carrots and gravy
Beef blade rubbed with garlic and thyme, slow roasted at 160C for 3 hours, with roast potatoes, carrots and gravy.
Bomont fried chicken with mash and slaw

Buttermilk chicken fried crisp and golden, with creamy mashed potato and pepper gravy, buttered corn and a crunchy coleslaw. Soak 1.5kg chicken pieces overnight in 500ml buttermilk with salt. Dredge in 300g flour seasoned with paprika, garlic powder and pepper and fry at 165C for 12 to 14 minutes until 74C inside. Mash 1kg boiled potatoes with butter and milk. Make gravy with 30g butter, 2 tbsp flour, 400ml milk and lots of pepper. Boil 4 corn cobs and butter them. Toss shredded cabbage with mayo and vinegar.
W: Popcorn bound in brown sugar and golden syrup caramel

Fresh popcorn bound in a sticky brown sugar and butter caramel with a pinch of salt, shaped into balls by hand and wrapped in paper. Pop 100g popcorn kernels in a little oil and tip into a large buttered bowl. Boil 200g brown sugar, 100g golden syrup and 60g butter for 3 minutes, then stir in a pinch of salt and half a tsp vanilla. Pour over the popcorn and toss with two spoons. Cool for 3 minutes, then butter your hands and press into 12 balls. Set on baking paper and wrap when firm.
K: Pineapple, orange and lemonade punch with scoops of lemon sorbet on top
Pineapple and orange juice topped with lemonade and a scoop of lemon sorbet in a big bowl with sliced oranges.

dishes.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day ahead, fry fresh

steps.text: Marinate the chicken in the buttermilk in the fridge, at least 4 hours or overnight.
Mix the flour, paprika and salt. Lift the chicken out of the buttermilk and dredge in the flour.
Fry in the oil at 180C in batches until crisp and cooked through. Drain on paper and serve hot with the honey.

veg.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day ahead, fry fresh

steps.text: Soak the cauliflower florets in the buttermilk in the fridge for at least 1 hour.
Mix the flour, paprika and salt. Lift the cauliflower out of the buttermilk and dredge in the flour.
Fry in the oil at 180C in batches until crisp and tender. Drain on paper and serve hot with the honey.
Mix the corn, flour, eggs, spring onions and paprika into a thick batter.
Fry spoonfuls in a little oil until golden on both sides.
Stir the chives through the sour cream for the dip and serve the fritters warm.
Rub the beef with the garlic, thyme and salt.
Roast covered at 160C for 2 hours, then add the potatoes and carrots to the tray.
Roast for another hour until the beef is tender.
Lift out the beef and vegetables to rest. Whisk the flour into the pan juices, add the stock and simmer into gravy. Serve after church.

veg.make_ahead: Gravy up to 1 day, reheat gently

steps.text: Trim the cauliflower, keeping it whole, and rub with the butter, garlic, thyme and salt.
Toss the potatoes and carrots in the oil and roast with the cauliflower, covered, at 200C for 40 minutes.
Uncover and roast another 40 minutes until the cauliflower is tender and deep golden.
Lift out the cauliflower and vegetables to rest. Fry the onion in the tray juices, whisk in the flour, add the stock and soy sauce and simmer into gravy. Serve after church.

s.note: Buttermilk-marinated chicken pieces fried crisp, honey for dipping
s.how: Marinate 600g chicken thigh pieces in buttermilk overnight. Dredge in flour mixed with paprika and salt. Fry at 180C for 5 minutes until crisp and cooked through. Drain on paper and serve hot with a small bowl of honey for dipping.

s.note: Golden corn fritters with a chive sour cream dip
s.how: Mix a drained can of corn with 100g flour, 2 eggs, sliced spring onions and a pinch of paprika. Fry spoonfuls in a little oil until golden on both sides. Stir chopped chives through sour cream for the dip and serve the fritters warm.

m.note: Garlic thyme beef blade roasted tender with potatoes, carrots and gravy
m.how: Rub a 1.5kg beef blade with garlic, thyme and salt. Roast covered at 160C for 3 hours until tender, adding 1kg potatoes and 4 carrots for the last hour. Make gravy from the pan juices and beef stock. Serve after church.

w.note: Popcorn bound in brown sugar and golden syrup caramel
w.how: Pop 100g popcorn kernels in a little oil and tip into a large buttered bowl. Boil 200g brown sugar, 100g golden syrup and 60g butter for 3 minutes, then stir in a pinch of salt and half a tsp vanilla. Pour over the popcorn and toss with two spoons. Cool for 3 minutes, then butter your hands and press into 12 balls. Set on baking paper and wrap when firm.

d.note: Pineapple, orange and lemonade punch with scoops of lemon sorbet on top
d.how: Pour 1L pineapple juice and 1L orange juice into a big punch bowl. Add sliced oranges and top with 1L cold lemonade. Float big scoops of lemon sorbet on top so it foams. Leave a ladle in the bowl and let everyone cut loose.
